areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Consistent fit via road safety, mobility and resilience with clear measurable indicators and efficient evidence-based solutions; moderate impact on specific stretches and relevant but non-majority resources.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Road-safety interventions reduce accidents with clear indicators, but modest resources and moderate impact, with no integrated public-security strategy.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Clear fit with drainage, slope stabilisation and aligned indicators, but limited share of resources and moderate impact in the covered stretches.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Indirect link via logistics fluidity and an innovative asset-management model, but indicators do not measure economic or logistics impacts, so impact is of little relevance.

areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Only indirect access benefits from better mobility; no objectives, components, indicators or resources aimed at public health.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Safer routes for students are an indirect benefit; no education-focused components, indicators or resources.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Training for vulnerable groups in the institutional component is complementary; no specific women-focused design or resources.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: General social benefits only; nothing directed at indigenous, quilombola or traditional communities.

areas.name: Anti-racism
areas.reason: Vulnerable-group training is complementary; no components, indicators or resources on racial equality.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Environmental actions relate to climate adaptation (area 202), not conservation or sustainable use; no dedicated components, indicators or resources.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Project is wholly road management, safety and adaptation; nothing on industrialisation or productive decarbonisation.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Modern road-management practices serve asset management, not science and technology system strengthening; no dedicated resources.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Training in the institutional component is limited and complementary; no employment indicators or targets.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Project is entirely road works and asset management with no energy-related design.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Hydrological-risk measures belong to area 202; only indirect drainage benefits, nothing on water supply or availability.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Possible tourist-flow benefits are indirect; no tourism-oriented design.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Effects on inequality are indirect from general road improvement; no components or targets aimed at it.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Only procedural social-communication mechanisms required by safeguards; no structured participation or transparency initiatives.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening is credited under road-related areas; it does not address broad state-capacity or federative cooperation.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: No digital transformation of public services or administration; only physical works and road-sector institutional support.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Road-sector institutional actions are not linked to fiscal balance, revenue or spending control; connection is only indirect.
